▸ The Proof — carousel (real graded data)

Post as one 5-slide carousel in this order, or re-share any single slide standalone during the week. Every number traces to 239,378 graded props. Tap "Copy caption" to grab the text.

1
COVER
We don't sell locks. We show math.
cover_the-proof.png
Most touts sell you locks. We'll show you the math instead. 🧵 4 receipts from 239,378 graded props — including the one edge that actually held up out of sample. Swipe. → bankrollkings.com
2
SLIDE 2
We say 80%. It hits 80%.
proof_01_calibration.png
When we say a pick is 80% to hit, does it actually hit 80%? We graded 239,378 props to find out. It does — top to bottom. That's calibration: the difference between a real model and a marketing line. → bankrollkings.com
3
SLIDE 3
58% hit. Still lost.
proof_02_roi.png
A 58% win rate sounds like a winner. It lost money. Here's the lesson most cappers won't teach you: hit rate flatters, ROI tells the truth. We show both — because we'd rather you learn the read than buy the lock. → bankrollkings.com
4
SLIDE 4
Wind kills totals.
proof_03_wind.png
We tested every 'edge' against 5,205 outdoor games. Almost all of them were already priced in. One survived: wind on totals. 15+ mph → 55.5% unders, +5.9% ROI on games the model never saw. The market's slow on weather. We're not. → bankrollkings.com
5
SLIDE 5
Hot hands are real.
proof_04_streak.png
Everyone chases the hot hand. Here's why the smart money doesn't. A streaking player really is producing more — that part's true. But the line already moved to match, before you ever clicked. The streak is real. The edge is gone. → bankrollkings.com

▸ Start Here — onboarding carousel (4 cards)

The "what even is this?" fix — a cover + 3 steps that walk a first-timer from blank slate to a smarter bet. Post as one carousel, pin it, or use as a link-in-bio explainer.

▸ Inside the App — feature series (13 cards)

The "what you actually get" pillar — every card promotes a real, live feature. These convert followers into subscribers, so end each with the CTA. Post one every day or two, mixed between proof cards and proverbs. Tap "Copy caption" for ready text.

▸ The Difference — positioning & value (5 cards)

The trust pillar — contrasts the honest approach against typical tout tactics, plus the $19.99 value card. Post the versus cards standalone or as a carousel; pin the value card. High-conversion; use sparingly so it doesn't read as constant selling.

▸ Myth or Money — myth-busting (6 cards)

Your reach plays — teach something true, no pick required. Includes dedicated Fantasy (name value + the sim engine) and Franchise Kings cards. Great as standalone posts; the format screenshots and shares well.

▸ King's Proverbs — 22 cards

The always-on drip. One per post, no caption needed beyond the line itself + a soft CTA. Caption template: "Proverb No. X — [the line]. More at bankrollkings.com". Rotate 2–3 a week; they never expire.

▸ Hashtag block

#SportsBetting #PlayerProps #BettingTwitter #SportsBettingTips #GamblingTwitter #BankrollManagement #SportsBettingModel

Use 3–5 per post, not all seven — mix in the sport/league of the day (#NFL, #WNBA, etc.).

▸ One rule for every post

Never post a number you can't trace to the graded data. Where we don't have the receipt, we teach the concept — we don't invent the stat. That honesty is the product. No "guaranteed", no "lock", no fabricated records.
